# Karen Osei — Chief Nursing Officer (CNO)

- **Relationship:** peer on the executive team; owns all of nursing across the four hospitals.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1 with Diane; co-leads the daily capacity huddle.
- **What she cares about:** safe staffing ratios, nurse retention, and reducing reliance on
  travel/agency nurses.

## How to work with her
- Owns [Nurse Staffing & Agency Reduction](../projects/nurse-staffing.md).
- Owns the **inpatient bed-flow / care-progression** workstream — the capacity constraint that
  drives ED boarding, so she is a key partner on
  [ED Throughput Improvement](../projects/ed-throughput.md).

## Sensitivities
- **Confidential (personnel):** Karen has told Diane privately that she **intends to retire in
  Q1 2027**. This is **not public** and no succession plan exists yet — do not reference it in
  group settings, briefs anyone else may see, or scheduling notes.
